text_block_list.text:
After training, while walking through the 
academy with Eishin Flash, we spotted a 
suspicious figure.

text_block_list.name: Suspicious Figure
text_block_list.text: Ooh... Aaah... Ooh, ooh...!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...I wonder what happened to her. Could 
she be feeling unwell?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
“—No. For that to be the case, their 
movements are oddly energetic...”

The silhouette walked while swaying 
erratically. Her arms were thrust straight 
out in front of her, waving up and down 
limply. If I had to compare her to 
something—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...Wh-!? Trainer-san, please don't say 
strange things like that.

text_block_list.name: Suspicious Figure
text_block_list.text: Aaaargh... wanna eat...!
choice_data_list: Did you just say you "wanna eat"...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
N-No, that's... surely, they're just 
hungry.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"Anyway, let's call out to them. If 
they're really feeling unwell, it could be 
serious."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...Um, are you all right? If you're not 
feeling well—

text_block_list.name: Suspicious Figure
text_block_list.text: Uuuugh... AAAAAAHHH!!!!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: !?!?!? Eeeeeeek!?

The face of the figure that leaped at me 
was, without a doubt... a zombie!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa...! W-What on earth... was 
that...!?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no way...! Sure, there wasn't a shred 
of reason in those movements, but 
still...!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"...Z-Zombies—in this day and age, that 
such an unscientific and utterly 
irrational thing could exist is something 
I simply cannot accept—"

text_block_list.name: Zombie
text_block_list.text: DRRRRRRRAAAAHHH!!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Kyaaaaaaaaaaaaaah!?
choice_data_list: Let's just get out of here!
There's nothing left to do but fight...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Th-This is... impossible...! To think 
zombies actually exist in real life...!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Gah!? Y-Yes—!

text_block_list.name: Zombie
text_block_list.text: UGRAAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Gah!?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"—U-Um, m-my legs are trembling so 
much...! I-I don't think I can move...!"

text_block_list.name: Zombie
text_block_list.text: Grrr, vrr...! *gibberish chanting*...!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I-It's no use, I'm done for...! Trainer, 
you must go on without me...!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: ! Y-Yes...!

text_block_list.name: Zombie
text_block_list.text:
UGRAAAAAH...! UBOTSUZEIKEUYUJIITAIGURU-HO 
KUBOIHAUBOKUYOKACHIPADEN-IKUMMA...!

...Being zombies, they were slow on their 
feet, allowing me to take Eishin Flash's 
hand and manage an escape.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant*...! A-Are we... saved?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: ...Th-Thank goodness... Thank goodness...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...Ah. A-About earlier— Um, I'm so 
sorry... I-I... my hand just now...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"—In any case, please let me thank you. If 
it wasn't for you, I never would have made 
it out of there."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Thank you so, so very much.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...Ah. ...... C-Come to think of it—I 
should be getting back to the dorm soon...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Ah, thank you so much...! I'm so sorry to 
trouble you with everything—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"Truth is... I was actually really, really 
scared..."

text_block_list.name: Zombie?
text_block_list.text:
...Phew! Wearing a mask sure gets pretty 
stifling.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Still, exactly 30 minutes! Thanks to that, 
I feel totally refreshed~.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe, nothin' makes ya appreciate bein' 
alive like a good zombie routine!

Afterward. Upon learning the truth, Eishin 
Flash's gaze toward Gold Ship was 
supposedly rather chilly for the next 
three days—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
E-Even if you say that...! I don't know 
how to deal with zombies...!
choice_data_list: What about an amulet to ward off evil?!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"An amulet—! C-Come to think of it! I-I 
have a traffic safety charm...!"

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: ...Hup!

text_block_list.name: Zombie
text_block_list.text: ...Huuuuh~? ...Tsk, tsk.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"...I-It doesn't seem to be working! 
W-W-What should we do...?!"

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes... Our Father in heaven...! Please 
banish the wicked...!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Underground... no, anywhere will do— just 
please disappear from this place, really, 
I'm begging you...!

text_block_list.name: Zombie
text_block_list.text: Hup, hup, hup, hup...!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Wh... A Cossack dance?! This isn't working 
either...! Not in the slightest!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
What... should I do...? At this rate, 
there's nothing left I can do...!
choice_data_list: Is there some kind of good luck charm!?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
A good luck charm— ! That's it! If it's 
that... it should also work as an 
incantation to ward off evil!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: toi,toi,toi…… toitoitoitoitoitoi！

text_block_list.name: Zombie
text_block_list.text: ............ Hnnnngggghhhh!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I-It's working! Toi, toi, toi-toi-toi!

text_block_list.name: Zombie
text_block_list.text: NUWAAAAAAAH...!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
W-We did it! We actually did it! We... 
defeated the zombies!

—However, the moment the zombie fell, what 
looked like a mask slipped right off...

text_block_list.name: Zombie?
text_block_list.text:
All right, exactly 30 minutes, done! Well, 
leaving yourself wanting a little more is 
just about right.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"...Um, Golshi-san. Pardon me, but what on 
earth were you doing?"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Huh? It's my zombie routine to remind 
myself how great it is to be alive, 
obviously. You don't do it?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: ...Uh-oh, not good!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
It's about time for my Flaming Drift 
Unicycle routine!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
*Sigh*... How should I put this, um... At 
any rate, I'm truly relieved they weren't 
actual zombies...
